{{Quote|The ROCKET was the favored conveyance of the Old Republic Rocket-jumper Elite Advance Unit, a feared corps of commandos famed for their extravagant behavior and battlefield bravery.|Doctor Itlar, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
The '''ROCKET''' was a [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]] model manufactured by [[Zim Systems]] and used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]]. It had four rocket outriggers used for controlling midair pitch and roll and generated thrust via the use of a chemical [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] cell. The latter allowed for the operation of the rocket pack in outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]] but also introduced the risk of [[Death/Legends|fatal]] explosion if hit by a shot in combat.

Introduced around [[11,000 BBY]], the ROCKET saw continued service with the Republic rocket-jumpers for at least [[3998 BBY|seven thousand years]], and its famed use by the unit led to rocket packs in general being a romanticized, if outdated, mode of transportation by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the weapons [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Itlar]] noted that the majority of the ROCKET units were still functional by that time.

==Description==
{{Quote|Rocket-jumpers typically treated their packs like swoopers treat their vehicles; ROCKETs that saw military service were often heavily modified to increase performance.|Doctor Itlar, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark" />}}
The ROCKET was a model of [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]] manufactured by [[Zim Systems]].<ref name="TotJC" /> It consisted of four rocket outriggers that were used for controlling midair pitch and roll<ref name="GaW" /> and were connected to a metal frame that held the wearer's [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. At the front were attached two [[Armor/Legends|armored]] shoulder pads as well as straps for securing the rocket pack.<ref name="TotJC" />

[[File:RocketJumper-TotJC.png|thumb|left|300px|A Republic rocket-jumper equipped with a ROCKET]]
The rocket pack contained a cell of [[Fire/Legends|combustible]] chemical<ref name="TotJC" /> solid<ref name="GaW" /> [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] that provided thrust.<ref name="TotJC" /> Unlike with [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]],<ref name="EGtWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> the rocket packs' design did not require outside [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] to operate, allowing for their<ref name="TotJC" /> optimal<ref name="GaW" /> use in outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]] as well. A ROCKET fuel cell had the capacity of ten charges, with each charge allowing the rocket pack to carry eighty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] either forty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] vertically or 120 meters horizontally. The chemical fuel cell of ROCKET also introduced a vulnerability due to the risk that it could explode<ref name="TotJC" /> with nearly guaranteed [[Death/Legends|fatal]] consequences for the wearer<ref name="GaW" /> if hit by a shot during combat.<ref name="TotJC" /> ROCKET weighed between forty and sixty kilograms<ref name="GaW" /> and cost 750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was<ref name="TotJC" /> a specialized item that was only available for sale in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

ROCKET was the most iconic piece of equipment of the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|Army]]. On most surface missions, the rocket-jumpers performed low-altitude jumps from [[Republic troop carrier]]s; however, on surprise insertions they were instead typically dropped from high altitude and then free-fell until they were less than one hundred meters from the ground, at which point the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] would ignite their rocket packs to rapidly slow their descent in [[Time/Legends|time]] for a gentle landing.<ref name="GaW" /> The rocket-jumpers frequently made extensive modifications to their ROCKETs in order to increase their combat performance,<ref name="TotJC" /> with the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Itlar]] noting in that regard the similarity to [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]] modifying their [[Swoop/Legends|vehicles]].<ref name="Gundark" />

==History==
{{Quote|Despite the dated construction, the majority of Zim Systems' units still function (though the fuel delivery system will have to be modified to accept modern propellants).|Doctor Itlar, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark" />}}
[[File:RocketJumper-GAW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A Republic rocket-jumper using the ROCKET]]
The ROCKET-wielding Republic rocket-jumpers came into being around [[11,000 BBY]]<ref name="GaW" /> when advances in<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref> reliable rocket pack technology allowed for the reinvention of previous forces using powered [[Para-wing glider|paragliders]]. The ROCKET continued to see service for at least seven [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]]<ref name="GaW" /> and was still in use by the time of the [[Second Battle of Onderon]]<ref name="TFNU2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref> in [[3998 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The rocket-jumper unit was dissolved in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] along with the rest of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as part of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].<ref name="GaW" />

During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to their [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] raids, which began more than four millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]], one of the earliest incarnations of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture that was known for its heavy use of jetpacks in battle, studied and improved military technology they had captured, including Republic rocket packs.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> By the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGtWT" /> which [[Declaration of a New Order|began]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the use of personal rocket packs was considered outdated,<ref name="EGtWT" /> with the design of ROCKET being obsolete.<ref name="Gundark" />

However, the Republic rocket-jumpers' famed use of the rocket packs led to the conveyances being perennially romanticized.<ref name="EGtWT" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="5 ABY">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' dates [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Itlar]]'s comment on the ROCKET to the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "40:8:5:67," which corresponds to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Doctor Itlar noted in an edition of the ''[[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]'' [[Black market/Legends|black market]] catalogue that, despite the age of their design, most of the ROCKET units were still functional by that time, although Itlar warned that the rocket packs' fuel delivery system needed modification to allow their use in tandem with contemporary propellants.<ref name="Gundark" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ROCKET-TFNU2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ROCKET in its original appearance in ''Tales of the Jedi &ndash; The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]
The rocket packs of the Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|second issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was written by [[Tom Veitch]], penciled by [[Tony Akins]],<ref name="TFNU2" /> and published on [[September 6]], [[1994]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54588/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_freedon_nadd_uprising_1994_2|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Freedon Nadd Uprising (1994) #2}}</ref> In [[1996]], the rocket pack was first identified as ROCKET in the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', a sourcebook authored by [[George R. Strayton]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TotJC" />

The rocket-jumper rocket packs were originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the devices was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the rocket packs was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''. The section, which drew upon material introduced in<ref name="Author's Cut" /> a chapter of the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''<ref name="GaW" /> authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], continued<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that book's practice of<ref name="GaW" /> erroneously<ref name="TotJC" /><ref name="EGtWT" /> describing the ROCKET as a jetpack<ref name="Author's Cut" /> instead of a rocket pack.<ref name="TotJC" />
